summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory, extracts the bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style payload — shuffled string-array with a runtime decoder function, hex-mangled identifiers, and no readable strings — and is not referenced by the package's declared build configuration. Bun is fetched specifically to execute this obfuscated code, bypassing Node-based static analysis. A React/UI component library has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and use it to run an opaque bundled script. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code (the obfuscated math_init.js) to execute on the installer's machine during npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
